causeDefinitions.target_file_not_indexed: No Semble index chunks exist for the qrel target file; discovery, file type, ignore, size, or parse/write eligibility must be inspected separately.
causeDefinitions.target_span_not_covered_by_index_chunks: The target file is indexed, but no stored chunk range overlaps the qrel symbol span.
causeDefinitions.target_file_not_retrieved_in_top100: The target span is indexed, but no result from its file appears in any sampled top-100 pool.
causeDefinitions.target_file_retrieved_but_relevant_chunk: The target span is indexed and its file appears in top 100, but the relevant chunk does not.
causeDefinitions.intermittent_candidate_membership: The relevant chunk appears in some but not all repeated top-100 results.
